doc.title: Herbie Hancock interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 18, 1995

title: Opportunity and the importance of everybody
summary: Hancock says someone usually gives you a chance or inspiration, so no one's life is trivial.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Somebody has to give you that hand, don’t they?

Sometimes not. Sometimes, well there’s always some kind of opportunity one way or the other. One way or the other, whether there’s somebody taking you somewhere, or whether a door being opened when something is needed and you happen to be at the right place at the right time. But in very, very many cases, maybe most cases, there is a person that gives you a chance somehow. Sometimes it’s a person that gives you inspiration. You never know. That’s why, by the way, it’s so important to not think of our lives as being trivial and not think of our daily life, just because we don’t have anything, doesn’t mean that we can’t be a great influence on someone who could have a dynamic influence on the rest of humanity. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
